name: @tabnas/zon
description: Zig Object Notation (ZON) parsing for the tabnas engine.

loss: Every field name is written in the quoted identifier form, .@"name", whether or not it is a bare identifier.
Strings are written double-quoted with Zig's escapes, never as multiline string literals.
A character literal and an enum literal are written as the value the reader resolved them to, so neither reads back as a literal.
An empty struct is written .{}, which ZON reads as an empty tuple, so an empty object reads back as an empty array.

An object whose only member is $big and holds an integer's digits, the reader's form of an integer no double holds exactly, is written as that integer, so it reads back as a number when a double holds the integer; any other object with a $big member is written as a struct.
ZON has no field name for the empty string, so the empty key is written as the field $empty, in the style of the reader's $big, and reads back as the key $empty.
ZON reads no U+0000 in a field name, so a field name holding one is written with U+FFFD in place of each U+0000, and reads back so.
